plugins.name: ppt-master
plugins.description: AI-driven SVG+PPTX generation. **v2.9.0** (synced upstream hugohe3 v2.11): pptx_intake multi-deck intake, presentation modes (briefing/narrative/pyramid/showcase/instructional), visual-styles catalog, LaTeX formula rendering, brand presets, topic-research/resume-execute workflows, richer object animations. **mosjin fork adds**: single content-panel layout guard in svg_quality_checker (#11 — flags empty header strip / first-line clip / underfilled panel) + page_order.txt manifest ordering in pptx_discovery (frame-id-named SVGs insert without renumbering; backward compatible) + `--absolute-links` (file:/// URLs for WPS/PowerPoint hyperlink resolution). Run `pip install -r requirements.txt` in the installed plugin dir for Python post-processing.
